sections.text_helper: Section 34.3.17 "Timer input XOR function" in chapter 34 (General-purpose timers (TIM12)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1307.
sections.section_content:
The TI1S bit in the TIM_CR2 register, allows the input filter of channel 1 to be connected to
the output of an XOR gate, combining the two input pins tim_ti1 and tim_ti2.
The XOR output can be used with all the timer input functions such as trigger or input
capture. It is useful for measuring the interval between the edges on two input signals, as
shown in Figure458.
[Figure 458. Measuring time interval between edges on 2 signals]
The XORPS control bit selects the position of the XOR gate, as shown in Figure459 and
Figure460, when the TI1S bit is set.
[Figure 459. XOR gate connection with TI1S = 1 and XORPS = 0]
[Figure 460. XOR gate connection with TI1S = 1 and XORPS = 1]
Two control bits TI1INV and TI2INV in the TIM_CR2 register can invert the tim_in1 and
tim_in2 signals prior entering the XOR gate.
The status of the tim_in1 and tim_in2 signals can be software polled using the TI1FS and
TI2FS bits in the TIM_SR register.
